subject: english-literature
title: Doorways into the Story
welcome_lead: Every novel has openings, turning points and tidy exits. Learn the vocabulary.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on exposition, inciting incident and structure terms.
final_note: You can now label each part of a story by its proper name.

concepts.def: Event that kicks off the main plot.
Short scene before the main story.

walkthroughs.body_html: The inciting incident disturbs the everyday and pushes the hero into action — Harry's Hogwarts letter, Frodo getting the Ring.
Denouement (French for 'untying') is the final unwinding after the climax — loose ends are tied off.
A prologue can deliver backstory, prophecy or a teaser. Romeo and Juliet's opening sonnet is a famous prologue.

options: Untying

mcqs.q: What is the function of dystopian fiction?
options: Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
Hamartia is the moment the tragic hero dies.
Dystopian fiction is just storytelling set in scary futures.
To critique tendencies in the writer's own society by extrapolating them into a nightmarish future — dystopias hold up a warning mirror to the present.

mcqs.q: What defines epic poetry as a genre?
options: Hamartia is the moment the tragic hero dies.
Epic means any poem that is very long.
Epic means any story with a battle in it.
Long narrative poems on heroic subjects, in elevated style, often invoking a muse, in medias res openings, and treating events of national or cosmic significance.
Dystopian fiction predicts what will actually happen in 100 years.
Hamartia is the moment the tragic hero dies.
Hamartia is the tragic hero's evil personality.
A fatal error or flaw in the tragic hero that leads to their downfall — sometimes a character defect, sometimes a mistake in judgement.
